vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-102276
vulnerability.description: brace-expansion: denial of service via stack exhaustion from crafted brace patterns (fixed in 5.0.10)

statements.status_notes: review-by: 2026-11-30. Found by the Trivy gate in cli-builder only, inside the npm that Node bundles (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm and semantic-release's own copy of it). No npm release ships the fixed brace-expansion yet: npm 12.2.0 and 11.21.0 both bundle 5.0.9. Accepted as a denial of service in a build-time tool, not shown unreachable: npm expands brace patterns from globs in package.json and ignore files.
statements.action_statement: Move to an npm release that bundles brace-expansion >= 5.0.11 and drop this statement. Re-checked on the review-by date.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-19534
vulnerability.description: undici: denial of service via an unrequested WebSocket subprotocol (fixed in 6.28.1)

statements.status_notes: review-by: 2026-11-30. Found by the Trivy gate in cli-builder only, inside the npm that Node bundles (both copies, as above). No npm release ships undici >= 6.28.1 yet. Accepted as a denial of service in a build-time tool, not shown unreachable: it needs a hostile WebSocket server and npm does not use undici's WebSocket client itself.
statements.action_statement: Move to an npm release that bundles undici >= 6.28.1 and drop this statement. Re-checked on the review-by date.
